name: The Thornbound Crawler
place: drags itself through the thorn thickets of the Scar, wrapped in its own briars
_doc: Stream E (M2). A bone-crawler wound in black thorns. It lashes with thorn whips (cross), drops thorns that stay as cover AND hurt to touch, and at half health tears loose: a roar you hide from behind the thorn heaps, which crack each time.

party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: The thicket moves. It is full of bones.
Thorns scrape over stone as something drags itself toward you.
say.death: The Thornbound Crawler falls apart into bones and dead briars.
say.reset: The Crawler drags itself back into the thicket.

thornfall.name: Thornfall
thornfall.say: Thorn heaps burst up out of the ground!

roar.name: Tearing Roar
roar.say: The Crawler rears up — get behind a thorn heap!

phases.name: Torn Loose
phases.say: The Crawler rips free of its briars!

enrage.say: The Crawler goes berserk among the thorns!
